verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.recurly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Per-section llms.txt files exist across the Engage, RevRec and other doc areas, and doc pages are served as .md files suited to agent consumption. Compass MCP also connects AI tools directly to the docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs effectively.
